title: I Will Love Them Freely
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler who brings the towel before the apology, and tonight Hosea’s people are healed and loved freely before they have made anything right. Sitting beside her pink-eared brother until he was ready to talk is exactly Willow’s kind of mercy.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because she gives mercy, being kind even after someone makes a mistake. In Willow’s world today: her big brother snapped at her over a spilled cup, then went quiet and pink-eared. Willow brought him a towel and sat beside him until he was ready to talk. Just like Heavenly Father promised to love His people freely, Willow learned that mercy does not wait to be earned.
